# Shiva carries earth for Vandi's pittu; beaten by the Pandya

`n-vandi-pittu` | Other Tamil Shaiva saints and poets | 3 songs

When the Vaigai flooded, every household owed a share of the embankment. Old Vandi had no one, so Shiva came as a labourer, ate her pittu as wages, slept on the job, and was struck with a cane by the king: the blow was felt by every creature.
